name: two-mode
facts: Every invocation picks its mode by reading ledger.md before doing anything else
Preflight mode runs when no engagement ledger exists, and is the only mode allowed to ask a question
Preflight covers §1 to §3: check security-audit is installed, offer to gitignore .audit/, create the engagement and start the loop
Cycle mode runs on every /loop firing while status is running, and never asks a question
Cycle mode covers §4a to §4d: run one audit, count new medium-or-higher findings, update the counter, then continue or report
The ledger's status moves from running to converged or max-cycles-reached, and then to done
